svg.text: LLM TRAINING MEMORY ANATOMY (16Ψ STATE + ACTIVATIONS): ZERO/FSDP2 VS. MEGATRON 3D
Hierarchical TP/PP/ZeRO-1 + Selective Activation Checkpointing Hits 58.8% MFU (-46.0% Cost)
128x H200 Training 70B Dense: Tier 1 Flat Global ZeRO-3 + Full Recompute (31.8% MFU) vs. Tier 4 (58.8% MFU, $262K/1T)
⛔ Why Training Needs `16Ψ` Bytes + Activation Traps
1. The `16Ψ` Mixed-Precision Static State Rule (`70B = 1,120 GB`):
• BF16 Weights (`2Ψ`) + BF16 Grads (`2Ψ`) + FP32 Master Weights (`4Ψ`)
+ FP32 Adam m (`4Ψ`) + FP32 Adam v (`4Ψ`) = `16 Bytes / param`!
2. Anti-Pattern A: Flat Global ZeRO-3 Across 128+ GPUs:
• Sharding weights across slow inter-node RDMA triggers per-layer
`All-Gather` & `Reduce-Scatter` (`42.5%` comm stall!)
3. Anti-Pattern B: Full Activation Checkpointing (`+33% FLOPs`):
• Recomputing every Linear GEMM in backward pass wastes 1/3 compute
Tier 1 Flat Global ZeRO-3 + Full Recompute Failure:
• Achieved Training MFU: Only 31.8% (42.5% network stall)
• Recompute Compute Tax: +33% extra FLOPs per step
• Cost per 1 Trillion Training Tokens: $485,000
🏆 Tier 4: HSDP/3D Parallelism + Selective Activation Ckpt
1. ZeRO-1/2/3 Exact Per-GPU State Equations ($N$ DP Ranks):
• Keep weight/TP sharding inside NVLink; run ZeRO-1 across nodes!
2. Selective Activation Checkpointing (`SAC` + FlashAttention):
• Checkpoints Linear GEMMs and only recomputes cheap Softmax/Dropout
— saving `70%` activation HBM at only `+3.8%` FLOPs overhead!
3. Decision Boundary: `FSDP2 HSDP` (`<=70B`) vs. `Megatron 3D` (`>=70B`):
• Use `FSDP2 HSDP` for fast SFT; `TP × 1F1B PP × ZeRO-1` for pretrain
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks (128x H200):
• Achieved Training MFU: 58.8% (+27.0 pts vs. Tier 1!)
• Cross-Node Communication Share: 6.4% (overlapped)
• Cost per 1T Training Tokens: $262,000 (-46.0% savings)
